share_title_rule: lead with the rainy commute only when rain or commute evidence exists
share_picture_rule: picture line may mention rain and route, but must not invent mood
playback_background_rule: rain profile only when rain evidence exists

share_title_rule: life mark can lead when first/restart/recovery evidence exists
share_picture_rule: scene can support the memory, but cannot overstate it as a major life event
playback_background_rule: fitness profile only when fitness/recovery evidence exists

share_title_rule: do not lead with mechanical continuity; use a soft factual fallback
share_picture_rule: describe records as daily traces, not emotional fuel
playback_background_rule: warmDaily or defaultSoft, never dramatic profile

share_title_rule: lead with out-of-town context only when city/travel evidence exists
share_picture_rule: use single-event wording unless duration evidence exists
playback_background_rule: travel profile only when trip/city evidence exists

share_title_rule: social scene can lead when friend/meal/meet evidence exists
share_picture_rule: warmth can be described from meeting evidence, without inventing intimacy
playback_background_rule: social profile only when gathering evidence exists

share_title_rule: fallback must stay factual when there is no strong life mark or scene
share_picture_rule: plain daily wording is acceptable; do not manufacture drama
playback_background_rule: defaultSoft profile when evidence is weak
